notes: Profile: mid-market ecommerce SaaS, vertical marketplace for niche retailers.
Primary problem: search results consistency and conversion drop on long-tail queries.
Team: 3 product engineers owning search, 1 data scientist, 1 infra eng.
Current infra: in-house ES + offline learning-to-rank pipeline, nightly scores show drift.
Ask: fast rerank endpoint to apply ML scores at serve time without migrating entire stack.
Quote from CTO: "We want predictable token costs and the ability to fallback to a cheaper model when tail load spikes."
Preference: start on Hosted API for quick integration, then move to Dedicated if throughput & SLOs require isolation.
Evaluation criteria: end-to-end latency under 120ms p95 for 3-token rerank step, cost per 1M requests, and ease of offline scoring integration.
Rerank details: using candidate set from ES (top 50), then call Redwood rerank endpoint to rescore top 10 for final ranking.
Offline work: data scientist will provide labeled eval set (~15k queries) and an initial scoring script (python).
POC plan: 2-week Hosted POC. Week1 integrate SDK + rerank calls on sampled traffic; Week2 measure p95/p99 and compare to baseline conversion uplift.
Notes on routing: want automatic fallback to quantized model during peak; ask about model pinning for A/B rollouts.
Security: require SAML SSO and KMS integration for Dedicated; retention policy: 30 days for request logs in Hosted, longer in Dedicated.
Cost sensitivity: willing to commit to Dedicated if expected ARR > $75k and if average cost per 1k requests < $0.75 after batching gains.
Action items assigned: Redwood - provide pricing spreadsheet, share sample rerank SDK snippet, open trial Hosted creds. Elysian - deliver eval set and sample ES candidate export.
